description.short: Understand visual messages and prepare replies; gated Teams prototype.
description.full: A prototype for contextual visual explanations and reviewed replies. The standalone local workflow supports images, GIFs, static stickers, custom-image emoji and Unicode emoji, with explicit AI actions, previews and manual insertion. Live Teams actions require verified authentication, Graph, processing, catalog and sharing configuration. Native Send remains required; nothing sends automatically.
